a11y.textureHelp: Draws a diagonal pattern over filled chart areas so series stay tellable apart without relying on colour. Printing and high-contrast mode turn this on automatically.

displayUnits.subtitle: How readings are shown throughout the portal. The station always records in m/s, hPa and °C — this changes only what you see, for everyone.

displayUnits.pressureHint: hPa and mbar are the same measurement under two names.

displayUnits.readOnly: Only an administrator can change display units.

errors.save: Could not save your display units.
